interpretation: A small velocity contribution can improve the in-sample aggregate, especially reverse, but the preferred alpha is not stable out of movie. Larger velocity weights are strongly harmful and reduce node recall after component pruning. Reject the mechanism and do not add alpha 0.25 to EXP192 post hoc.
